sloka: यदा तु तद्वनं श्वेत अगस्त्यः सुमहानृषिः ।आगमिष्यति दुर्धर्षस्तदा कृच्छ्राद्विमोक्ष्यते ।। ७.७८.१९ ॥
transliteration: yadā tu tadvanaṁ śveta agastyaḥ sumahānṛṣiḥ ।āgamiṣyati durdharṣastadā kṛcchrādvimokṣyate ।। 7.78.19 ॥

translations.english: But, O Śveta, when the great and unconquerable sage Agastya comes to that forest, then you will be liberated from your distress.
